# pb-master: analysis note (pilot)

> Status: **DRAFT, review ke liye**. Sirf `unitMaster` poora padha gaya hai. Baaki entries ke baare me abhi sirf folder ke naam aur file count pata hain; unka logic abhi analyse nahi hua (har group ke liye alag note aayega).
> Source: `legacy-gwt/paperbiz/master/src/paperbiz/master/` (58 entry folders, ~720 java files).
> Naya module: `pb-master`, package `com.paperbiz.master.*` (user ne confirm kiya).

## 1. Master module kya hai
Ye module ERP ke saare **master data** screens ka hai: unit, item, party, warehouse, price list, settings, permissions, import/export, waghera. Baaki sab modules (sales, purchase, store...) inhi masters ko lookup ke taur par use karte hain.

Har entry GWT me teen hisson me bati hai:

| Hissa | Kaam | Naye project me |
|---|---|---|
| `client/` (`X.java`, `X_Dsg.java`) | GXT screen (form, buttons, popups) | Next.js screen (baad me) |
| `shared/` (`X_Mdl`, `X_Vld`, `X_Srv`) | Model, validator, RPC interface | DTO + validation + REST contract |
| `server/` (`X_SrvImpl`) | SQL aur business logic | Spring `@Service` + `@RestController` |

## 2. Common pattern (har master entry me wahi)
Ye `unitMaster` se samjha gaya hai. Simple masters me ye lagbhag same hai.

### 2.1 Screen ke buttons aur unka flow (`DmTopControl`)
| Button | Kya hota hai |
|---|---|
| **New** | Form saaf, fields edit-mode me, default values bharti hain (jaise default GST unit), focus pehle field par |
| **Edit** | Form edit-mode me. Agar record `system generated` hai to naam lock rehta hai, sirf baaki fields badal sakte hain |
| **Save** | Mode **New** me seedha save. Mode **Edit** me pehle **Modify Reason** popup aata hai, uske OK ke baad save |
| **Delete** | `system generated` record par rok: "Record is system generated. You can't delete this record." Warna confirm popup ("Are you sure?"), phir Modify Reason popup, phir delete |
| **Card (navigator)** | Saari codes ki list laata hai (naam ke order me), user usme se record chun kar kholta hai |
| **Find** | Paged search popup. Record chunne par wo load hota hai |
| **Print** | Is entry me khali (kuch nahi karta) |
| **Other** | Menu: Import / Export CSV waghera |
| **Close** | Screen band |
| Permission | Screen khulte waqt user ki menu permission se New/Edit/Delete/Print buttons on/off hote hain |

### 2.2 Server ke methods (har entry me wahi set)
| Method | Logic |
|---|---|
| `getNavigator` | Table se saari `code` naam ke order me |
| `getMoveRec(key)` | Ek row padhna, lookup tables join karke naam laana, enum ko text banana. **Purana record session me yaad rakhta hai** (baad me change-log ke liye) |
| `saveRecord(model)` | Neeche 2.3 dekhiye |
| `deleteRecord(key, reason)` | Ek transaction me delete, phir log (reason ke saath) |
| `getFind(helper, toEnd)` | Paged search |
| `getTxtH...` lookups | Popup lookups (paged, filter ke saath) |
| `getSuggestion...` | Auto-suggest ke liye naam |
| `iniDefaultValues` | New record ke liye default values |
| `exportCSV` | Import-data wale CSV format me export |

### 2.3 Save ka logic (New aur Edit)
1. **Validator** (`X_Vld.chkSave`) chalta hai. Fail hone par error code ke saath message.
2. Naam se **extra spaces hata dena**.
3. **New** hai to `code` khali hota hai. Naya code **`getSerialNoInteger`** se banta hai (neeche 3.1).
4. **Duplicate check:** same naam (case-insensitive) kisi aur code par ho to error `"<X> Name already exists."`.
5. Audit fields bharna (neeche 3.2).
6. **New** par `INSERT`, **Edit** par `UPDATE`. Sab ek transaction me. Error aaye to rollback.
7. Commit ke baad **log** (neeche 3.3).

## 3. Shared concerns (ye `pb-master` me nahi, shared library me jaayenge)
Har entry me ye dohraya gaya hai. Naye project me ye ek jagah banenge.

### 3.1 Serial number (`getSerialNoInteger`)
- DB ka stored procedure **`exec getCode :tableName, :siteCode, 0`** chalta hai. Ye per-table counter deta hai (DB schema me pehle se hai, use badalna nahi).
- Naya code = `"1"` + site code (4 digit, khali ho to `0000`) + counter (4 digit).
- Ek `BigInt` version bhi hai (counter 14 digit).
- **Dhyan:** counter DB me hai, to naye code me bhi isi procedure ko call karna hoga. Apna counter mat banana.

### 3.2 Audit fields
- **New:** `preparedBy` (user + time), `preparedDt`, `preparedByIP`.
- **Edit:** `u_name` (user + time), `u_EntDt` (modify date).
- User naam, time (server ka time), IP **session** se aate hain.
- `isSystemGenerated` flag: `1` = system banata hai, user delete nahi kar sakta.

### 3.3 Modify reason aur change log
- **Edit aur Delete** par user se "reason" maanga jaata hai (popup `ModifyReason`). **New** par nahi.
- Save/delete ke baad `saveLog` chalta hai: key aur reason ki jaanch (khali ho to error), phir **purana model** (session se) aur **naya model** ki tulna karke field-wise badlaav log hota hai (`ModifyReason_Server.saveNew`).
- Log me: action (NEW/EDIT/DELETE), doc id, module, menu, table ka naam, reason code aur naam.
- **Dhyan:** purana record abhi session me rakha jaata hai. Naye project me session ke bajaye request me ya DB se purana record padhna hoga.

### 3.4 Lookup, Find, paging
- Saare lookups aur Find `DmHelper` (page size, current page, filter) se paged chalte hain.
- Enum-based lookup (jaise unit nature) ke liye server enum ki list ko memory me filter karke deta hai.

### 3.5 Permissions
- Screen kholte waqt `UserMenu` permission se buttons control hote hain.
- Group/site/additional permission ki alag screens bhi hain (group 4 me).

### 3.6 Import / Export CSV
- Export: server ek CSV file banata hai (session ke folder me), header **import-data ka format** hota hai, phir client file download karta hai.
- Import: `importData` entry aur `selfToolkit` ka `ImportData_Server` use hota hai.

### 3.7 Multi-company DB
- Har request me company ka DB naam session se aata hai aur usi DB par query chalti hai.
- **Dhyan:** connection pool me catalog leak hone ka risk (ek company ka data dusri me dikhe) design me pehle se sochna hai.

Pricing aur scheme **sabse last** me.

## 5. Sample analysis: `unitMaster`
Files: `UnitMaster.java` (574), `UnitMaster_Dsg.java` (200), `UnitMaster_SrvImpl.java` (733), `UnitMaster_Mdl` (77), `UnitMaster_Vld` (16), `Find_Mdl` (49).

### 5.1 Data
- **Main table:** `unitmast`
- **Join/lookup tables:** `gstUnitMast` (GST unit ka naam, `manualCode` se default)
- **Enum:** `STEnum.UnitNature` (unit ka nature, dropdown ki tarah)

| Field (screen) | DB column (`unitmast`) | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Unit Name | `unit` | Mandatory, duplicate nahi (case-insensitive). Length limit code me nahi (DB column se) |
| (key) | `code` | Naya `getSerialNoInteger("unitmast")` se |
| Decimal Places | `decimalPlaces` | **4 se zyada nahi** ("Decimal places can't be greater than 4.") |
| GST Unit | `gstUnitCode` | Lookup `gstUnitMast`, **zaroori** |
| Nature | `nature` | Enum, **zaroori** |
| (system) | `isSystemGenerated` | `1` = Yes. New record par hamesha `0` |
| (audit) | `preparedBy`, `preparedDt`, `preparedByIP`, `u_name`, `u_EntDt` | Section 3.2 |

### 5.2 Validations (`UnitMaster_Vld.chkSave`)
1. Unit name: **mandatory** (`isValidText`: khali nahi hona chahiye, message `"Unit Name is mandatory."`).
2. Decimal places > 4 to error (code 200).
3. GST unit: mandatory.
4. Unit nature: mandatory.

Note: `isValidText(value, label, N)` ka `N` **error number** hai (client us number se wo field highlight/focus karta hai), length limit nahi. Isliye validator list me "(Text)" ka matlab "mandatory text" hai. Har field ka error number har entry file ke Validator section me hai; REST me ye field-name se map hoga.
5. Server par: naam duplicate to `"Unit Name already exists."`; key khali to `"Invalid key."`.

### 5.3 Screen behaviour
- **New:** form saaf, **default GST unit** bharta hai (`iniDefaultValues`: `gstUnitMast` me `manualCode` match karne wali row).
- **Edit:** agar record `system generated` hai to **Unit Name lock**, sirf Decimal Places par focus. Warna Unit Name par focus.
- **Delete:** system generated par rok. Warna confirm, phir Modify Reason, phir delete.
- **Unit Name** field auto-suggest hai (`getSuggestionUnit`: `SELECT unit FROM unitMast`).
- **GST Unit** aur **Nature** popup lookups hain (paged).
- Find popup columns: code, name, decimal places, GST unit name, nature.

### 5.4 REST API (design ka prastav, abhi approve nahi)
Base path `/api/master/units`:

| Method | Path | Kaam |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/navigator` | Saari codes |
| GET | `/{code}` | Ek record |
| POST | `/` | Naya (code server banata hai) |
| PUT | `/{code}` | Edit (Modify Reason body me) |
| DELETE | `/{code}` | Delete (Modify Reason body me) |
| GET | `/find?page=&size=&q=` | Paged search |
| GET | `/lookups/gst-units`, `/lookups/natures` | Paged lookups |
| GET | `/suggestions` | Naam ke suggestions |
| GET | `/defaults` | New ke default values |
| GET | `/export` | CSV |

### 5.5 Naye code me kya alag hoga (design points)
- Error: purana `DmResult.status/errorMessage` ki jagah HTTP status + error body. Messages wahi rahenge.
- Transaction: ek service method = ek transaction.
- Purana record change-log ke liye request me DB se padhna (session me nahi).
- `isSystemGenerated`, duplicate check, 4-decimal limit, delete ki rok: **jaise hain waise**.

## 6. Abhi pata nahi / TBD
- `getSerialNoInteger` ke stored procedure `getCode` ka andar ka logic DB me hai (hamare paas nahi). Behaviour wahi rahega kyunki hum use call karenge.
- Print button is entry me khali hai. Baaki entries me print/report hai to unka alag note.
- Permission ka poora model (group, site, additional) group 4 me analyse hoga.

## 7. Aage ka kaam (approval ke baad)
1. Is note par user ki review.
2. Group 1 (simple masters) ke baaki 25 entries ko `unitMaster` se compare karke note: kaun si entry me kya alag hai (extra fields, extra validations, extra tables).
3. Phir group 2, 3, 4, 5, aur sabse last 6.

### B3. Cross-cutting (har entry ko yaad rakhna hai)

#### 3.1 `SubGroup` family (account master)
Party, customer, supplier, manufacturer, employee, division, department aur warehouse **sab `subgroup` table me** (account master) save hote hain; `subgroup.filterNature` (`subgroupNature.manualCode`) batata hai ki ye kaun sa master hai.

| filterNature code | Master | ID stored proc |
|---|---|---|
| `PT` | partyMaster | getPartyId |
| `CT` | customerMaster | getCustomerId |
| `SU` | supplierMaster | getSupplierId |
| `MF` | manufacturerMaster | getManufacturerId |
| `EM` | employeeMaster | getEmployeeId |
| `DV` | divisionMaster | getDivisionId |
| `DP` / `GD` / `PC` | departmentMaster (department, godown, ...) | - |
| `CM` | masterSitePermission me use | - |

Saath ki tables: `subgroup2` (extra), `subgroupsitelist` (site assignment), `bankDetail`, `addressBook`, `subGroupAreaList`, `subgroupItemCategory`. `swapPartyAccountMaster` sirf `filterNature` badalta hai. **Design idea (aapse poochkar):** naye code me ek common "account master" service + alag controllers.

#### 3.2 Item family
`itemMast` me item, finished item, **other charges** aur **service** sab save hote hain (itemType `FM` finished, `SM` stock/other; `itemCat`, `itemGroup`, `itemMakeMast` unke masters). `hsnMast` HSN rates ko items me propagate karta hai.

#### 3.3 Doosre modules ki classes jo master call karta hai (inhe `pb-self-toolkit`/`dm-toolkit` me pehle banana hoga)
| Class | Kaam | Kaun use karta hai |
|---|---|---|
| `ModifyReason_Server.saveNew` (dm-toolkit) | change log + reason (46 jagah) | sab |
| `ImportData_Server.getCSVFormats` (selfToolkit) | import/export CSV format | 17 entries |
| `DmFileManager_Server.manageLinkFileCollection` | attach files (Mongo) | 9 |
| `DmGUI_Server` (get/save/deleteViaConfigCode) | configurable extra fields (GUI template) | party family, price list |
| `PriceList_Server` (selfToolkit) | price list save/delete/overhead | priceListMaster, partyPriceList |
| `Scheme_Server` (selfToolkit) | scheme save/delete/close | scheme, partyScheme |
| `WalkThrough_Server` (dm-toolkit) | approval workflow | itemMaster, finishedItemMaster |
| `Stock_Server` | `isInventoryAccountingActive`, `deleteUnusedItemBatches` | item masters, env setting |
| `DmTermsConfig_Server` | terms & conditions config | party family |
| `PolicyTrans_Server` | policy transactions | policyMaster |

#### 3.4 DB stored procedures jo master call karta hai
`getCode(table, site, 0)` (serial no, sab), `getItemManualCode(vType, fieldUDT)`, `getFinishedItemManualCode`, `getServiceManualCode`, `getPartyId`, `getCustomerId`, `getSupplierId`, `getManufacturerId`, `getEmployeeId`, `getDivisionId`. Ye DB me pehle se hain; naye code me inhe seedha call karna hai.

#### 3.5 Optimistic lock (record change hone par rok)
`u_EntDt_LatestLine` wale entries: packSize, finishedItem, policy, tradeDocumentEntry, transpoterRateContract. Server DB ka timestamp client ke bheje timestamp se milata hai; alag ho to **"Record has been changed, can't update record, refresh record then update"**.

#### 3.6 Legacy quirks (behaviour same rakhna hai ya theek karna hai? aapko decide)
- `classificationMaster`: validator label "BF", duplicate message "Shift Name already exists.".
- `varietyMaster`: label "Verify", method `getSuggestionVerify`.
- Simple masters me delete par **in-use check nahi** (DB FK error ka message user ko dikhta hai). Party family me `addressBook` check hai.
- `areaMaster` insert me `U_EntDt` = `preparedDt`.
- `DmShared.isValidText(value, label, N)` = **mandatory check** (khali ho to `"<label> is mandatory."`); `N` **error number** hai jisse UI us field par focus karta hai. Length limit nahi. Har entry ke Summary me "Validations: X (Text)" ka matlab "X mandatory text" hai; `(Amount)` = amount > 0 mandatory (`isValidAmount`).

#### 3.7 Security / sensitive
`dscMaster` (password + PFX file), `environmentSetting*` (settings), `additionalUserPermission` (permissions). SQL me kuch jagah string concat (`{...}` jahan IN-lists / dynamic where); naye code me sab parameterized banana hai.

### B4. Agle kadam
1. User review ke baad **design**: common base (`MasterCrudService` jaisa pattern) + REST contract (`pb-master.md` sec 5.4 ka expanded).
2. Pehle shared pieces: serial no, audit, modify-reason log, paging, permissions (library modules).
3. Phir simple masters (unit se shuru), fir baaki groups, **pricing sabse last**.

### Notes (hand-written)
- **Hierarchy:** `areaMast.parentCode` + closure table **`areaMastPath(code, sNo, parentCode)`** (har area ke saare ancestors ki rows). Save par ye path rebuild hota hai, aur us area ke saare descendants ke path bhi update hote hain.
- Parent lookup me area khud aur uske descendants nahi aate; save par bhi `"Can't use an 'Area' as its 'Parent Area'!"`.
- Delete: agar kisi area ka parent ye ho (`areaMastPath` me `parentCode`) to `"Record is in use. You can not delete it."`; warna `areaMastPath` phir `areaMast` delete.
- Insert me `U_EntDt` ko `preparedDt` ka value bhi bheja jaata hai (legacy behaviour).

### Validator `DivisionMaster_Vld`
```java
public class DivisionMaster_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(DivisionMaster_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName(), "Account name", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getDisplayName(), "Display name", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getAccGroup(), "A/c group", 300);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getNatureCode(), "nature", 500);
        DmShared.isValidEMail(mrTemp.getEmail(), 400);
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getCity(), "City", 550);
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).length() != 10) {
                throw new DmException(1000, "PAN should be of 10(Ten) characters.");
            } else {
                DmShared.isValidPanNo(mrTemp.getPan(), 1000);
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Registered.getId()))
                || DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Composite.getId()))) {
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGsTin(), "GSTIN No.", 700);
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGsTINDate(), "GSTIN Date", 800);
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTin()).equalsIgnoreCase("")
                || !DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(600, "For defining GST detail, you should have to fill Party Type first.");
            } else if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(1000, "Please fill the PAN No.");
            } else {
                DmShared.isValidGSTIN(mrTemp.getStateNumericCode(), mrTemp.getPan(), mrTemp.getGsTin(), 700);
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Unregistered.getId()))) {
            if (mrTemp.isGstApplicable() == true) {
                if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTin()).equalsIgnoreCase("") || !DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    throw new DmException(850, "In case of unregistered party type, you should not fill GSTIN No. and GSTIN Date.");
                }
                if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(900, "In case of unregistered party type AADHAAR No. or PAN No. is mandatory.");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).getTime() > (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getCurrentDate())).getTime()) {
                throw new DmException(800, "GSTIN Date should not be greater than current date.");
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).length() != 12) {
                throw new DmException(925, "AADHAAR No. should be 12 digit.");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class WarehouseMaster_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(WarehouseMaster_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName().trim(), "Warehouse Name ", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getStackTag().trim(), "Stack ", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getRackTag().trim(), "Rack ", 300);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getIsActiveText().trim(), "Active", 1200);
        boolean flagCheckGstDetail = false;
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getLegalName()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                || !DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getTradeName()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                || !DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGstTin()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                || !DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getGstDate()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            flagCheckGstDetail = true;
        }
        if (flagCheckGstDetail) {
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getLegalName(), "Legal Name", 400);
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getTradeName(), "Trade Name", 600);
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getAddress1(), "Address", 601);
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getCityCode(), "City", 700);
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getStateNumericCode()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(700, "Define state numeric code in " + mrTemp.getCityName() + "!");
            }
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPin(), "PIN", 800);
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPanNo()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            DmShared.isValidPanNo(mrTemp.getPanNo(), 1001);
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getMobile()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            DmShared.isValidMobile(mrTemp.getMobile(), 1002);
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getEmail()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            DmShared.isValidEMail(mrTemp.getEmail(), 1100);
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGstTin()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                || !DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getGstDate()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGstTin(), "GSTIN", 900);
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGstDate(), "GSTIN Date", 1000);
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPanNo(), "PAN", 1001);
            DmShared.isValidGSTIN(mrTemp.getStateNumericCode(), mrTemp.getPanNo(), mrTemp.getGstTin(), 900);
        }
    }
}
```

### Validator `ManufacturerMaster_Vld`
```java
public class ManufacturerMaster_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(ManufacturerMaster_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName(), "Account name", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getDisplayName(), "Display name", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getAccGroup(), "A/c group", 300);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getNatureCode(), "nature", 500);
        DmShared.isValidEMail(mrTemp.getEmail(), 400);
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getCity(), "City", 550);
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).length() != 10) {
                throw new DmException(1000, "PAN should be of 10(Ten) characters.");
            } else {
                DmShared.isValidPanNo(mrTemp.getPan(), 1000);
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Registered.getId()))
                || DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Composite.getId()))) {
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGsTin(), "GSTIN No.", 700);
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGsTINDate(), "GSTIN Date", 800);
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTin()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(1000, "Please fill the PAN No.");
            } else {
                DmShared.isValidGSTIN(mrTemp.getStateNumericCode(), mrTemp.getPan(), mrTemp.getGsTin(), 700);
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Unregistered.getId()))) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTin()).equalsIgnoreCase("") || !DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(850, "In case of unregistered party type, you should not fill GSTIN No. and GSTIN Date.");
            }
            if (mrTemp.isGstApplicable() == true) {
                if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(900, "In case of unregistered party type AADHAAR No. or PAN No. is mandatory.");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).getTime() > (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getCurrentDate())).getTime()) {
                throw new DmException(800, "GSTIN Date should not be greater than current date.");
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).length() != 12) {
                throw new DmException(925, "AADHAAR No. should be 12 digit.");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class MachineMaster_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(MachineMaster_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName().trim(), "Machine Name", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getActiveName().trim(), "Active", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getMachineTypeName().trim(), "Type", 300);
        if (DmShared.iNull(STEnum.MachineTypeCode.WEIGHMENT.getId()).intValue() == DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getMachineTypeCode()).intValue()) {
            {
                DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getWtUnitName().trim(), "Weight Unit", 400);
            }
            if (DmShared.iNull(STEnum.MachineTypeCode.WEIGHMENT.getId()).intValue() != DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getMachineTypeCode()).intValue()) {
                {
                    if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getWtUnitCode()).intValue() > 0) {
                        throw new DmException(400, "Unit is not required for selected Type.");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Validator `ServiceMaster_Vld`
```java
public class ServiceMaster_Vld {
    public ServiceMaster_Vld() {
    }
    public static void chkSave(ServiceMaster_mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getCategoryTag(), "Category", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName(), "Name", 300);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGroupTag(), "Group", 400);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSkuTag(), "SKU", 500);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getActiveTag(), "Active", 600);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getTypeTag(), "Type", 700);
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getTypeManualCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("OI")) {
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getHsn(), "SAC", 800);
        }
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGstNatureText(), "GST Nature", 900);
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getMapWithFieldTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getUsedInCode()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(1000, "Used In is Mandatory.");
            }
        }
        boolean isItsRateSlabExists = false;
        for (GrdItsRateSlab_Mdl grdRateITS_Mdl : mrTemp.getGrdRateIts_Mdls()) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(grdRateITS_Mdl.getGstTypeCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getTaxBasedOnTag()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    throw new DmException(19000, "GST Based On is Mandatory");
                }
                if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getTaxBasedOnTag()).equalsIgnoreCase("1")) {
                    if (!isItsRateSlabExists) {
                        isItsRateSlabExists = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getTaxBasedOnTag()).equalsIgnoreCase("1")) {
            if (!isItsRateSlabExists) {
                throw new DmException(19000, "Rate Slab wise GST is Mandatory.");
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getValue()).intValue() > 0) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getServiceEvalTypeCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(20000, "Valuation Type is Mandatory.");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Validator `PolicyMaster_Vld`
```java
public class PolicyMaster_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(PolicyMaster_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPolicyNo().trim(), "Policy No.", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getInsuranceCompany().trim(), "Insurance Company", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getFromDate().trim(), "From Date", 300);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getToDate().trim(), "To Date", 400);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getEntryDate().trim(), "Entry Date", 500);
        if (!DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getFromDate()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("") && !DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getToDate()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if ((DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getToDate()).getTime() <= (DmShared.convertDate(DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getFromDate())).getTime()))) {
                throw new DmException(400, "To Date should be greater than From Date.");
            }
        }
        DmShared.isValidAmount(mrTemp.getAmt().trim(), "Amount", 600);
    }
}
```

```java
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGstNatureTag(), "GST Nature is mandatory", 21200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getItsBasedOnTag(), "GST Based On is mandatory", 21300);
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPurchaseUnitSkuCode()).equalsIgnoreCase(DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getSaleUnitSkuCode()))) {
            if (DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getConversionRatePurchase()).doubleValue() != DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getConversionRateSale()).doubleValue()) {
                throw new DmException(9000, "Purchase conversion rate and sale conversion rate should be same.");
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getSkuTag()).longValue() == DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getSaleUnitSkuCode()).longValue()) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getConversionRateSale()).equalsIgnoreCase("1")) {
                throw new DmException(10000, "Sale conversion rate should be 1.");
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getSkuTag()).longValue() == DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getPurchaseUnitSkuCode()).longValue()) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getConversionRatePurchase()).equalsIgnoreCase(DmShared.xNull("1"))) {
                throw new DmException(11000, "Purchase conversion rate should be 1.");
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getConversionRatePurchase()).longValue() <= 0) {
            throw new DmException(12000, "Purchase conversion rate should be greater than 0.");
        }
        if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getConversionRateSale()).longValue() <= 0) {
            throw new DmException(13000, "Sale conversion rate should be greater than 0.");
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAllowNegetiveStockCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            throw new DmException(15000, "Negative Stock is mandatory.");
        }
        boolean isItsRateSlabExists = false, isItsExists = false;
        for (GrdItsRateSlab_Mdl grdRateITS_Mdl : mrTemp.getGrdLocationWiseGst_Mdls()) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(grdRateITS_Mdl.getGstTypeCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getItsBasedOnTag()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    throw new DmException(19000, "GST Based On is Mandatory");
                }
                if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getItsBasedOnTag()).equalsIgnoreCase("1")) {
                    if (!isItsRateSlabExists) {
                        isItsRateSlabExists = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                isItsExists = true;
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getItsBasedOnTag()).equalsIgnoreCase("1")) {
            if (!isItsRateSlabExists) {
                throw new DmException(19000, "Rate Slab wise GST is Mandatory.");
            }
        } else {
            if (!isItsExists) {
                throw new DmException(19100, "GST Type is Mandatory.");
            }
        }
    }
```

### Notes (hand-written)
- **Menu:** "Item Master Old" (`ITEM_MASTER_OLD`) yahi screen kholta hai. (Menu "Item Master" `finishedItemMaster` kholta hai.)
- **Naya item:** code `getSerialNoBigInt("itemmast")`; **walk-through** (approval workflow) `WalkThrough_Server.applyWalkThrough`; manual code stored procedure **`getItemManualCode(vType, fieldUDT)`** (table-valued parameter `dbo.fieldUDT` me itemName/itemGroup/itemCat).
- **"Item used" (`checkItem`):** item in tables me ho (`stock`, `itemBatch`, `pBillDetail`, `pChallanDetail`, `requisitionDetail`, `indentDetail`, `enquiryDetail`, `quotationDetail`) to **SKU, purchase unit, sale unit, dono conversion rates badal nahi sakte**.
- **Negative stock:** `Allow negative stock = No` tabhi jab current batch stock negative nahi (`itemBatchStock.balanceQty<0` check). Inventory accounting active ho to Yes tabhi allowed jab negative stock exist kare (rule alag-alag direction).
- Children tables: `itemSiteList`, `alternativeItem`, `itemRestrictedToDepartment`, `approvedVendors`, `itemImpurityMast/Detail` (QC parameters, `saveQCParameter`), `itemITSDetail` (rate slab GST), `itemDepartmentInfo` (min/max/reorder per site).
- `setActive`: item active/inactive. `getDefaultValues`: `enviroCompany.isInventoryAccountingActive` null ho to error.
- Delete: 7 tables (neeche summary); in-use check code me nahi (DB FK).

### Validator `FinishedItemMaster_Vld`
```java
public class FinishedItemMaster_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(FinishedItemMaster_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName(), "Item Name", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGroupTag(), "Item Group", 300);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getCategoryTag(), "Item Category", 400);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSkuTag(), "SKU", 500);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getConsignmentTag(), "Consignment Item", 600);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getFlowThroughTag(), "Flow Through", 1000);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getHighValueTag(), "High Value", 2000);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getReturnableItemTag(), "Returnable Item", 3000);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getBilledItemTag(), "   Billed Item", 4000);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPurchaseUnitSkuCode(), "Purchase Unit", 7000);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSaleUnitSkuCode(), "Sale Unit", 8000);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getConversionRatePurchase(), "Purchase Conversion Rate", 8500);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getConversionRateSale(), "Sale Conversion Rate", 9500);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPoReqTag(), "PO Required", 16000);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSoReqTag(), "SO Required", 16100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getLabRequiredTag(), "Lab Required", 16500);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getIndentReqTag(), "Indent Required", 17000);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getQuotationReqTag(), "Quotation Required", 18000);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSaleDiscountAllowTag(), "Sales Discount Allow", 20000);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSaleRateEditableTag(), "Sales Rate Editable", 21000);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getHsnCode(), "HSN/SAC", 21100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGstNatureTag(), "GST Nature", 21200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getItsBasedOnTag(), "GST Based On", 21300);
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPurchaseUnitSkuCode()).equalsIgnoreCase(DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getSaleUnitSkuCode()))) {
            if (DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getConversionRatePurchase()).doubleValue() != DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getConversionRateSale()).doubleValue()) {
                throw new DmException(9000, "Purchase conversion rate and sale conversion rate should be same.");
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getSkuTag()).longValue() == DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getSaleUnitSkuCode()).longValue()) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getConversionRateSale()).equalsIgnoreCase("1")) {
                throw new DmException(10000, "Sale conversion rate should be 1.");
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getSkuTag()).longValue() == DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getPurchaseUnitSkuCode()).longValue()) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getConversionRatePurchase()).equalsIgnoreCase(DmShared.xNull("1"))) {
                throw new DmException(11000, "Purchase conversion rate should be 1.");
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getConversionRatePurchase()).longValue() <= 0) {
            throw new DmException(12000, "Purchase conversion rate should be greater than 0.");
        }
        if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getConversionRateSale()).longValue() <= 0) {
            throw new DmException(13000, "Sale conversion rate should be greater than 0.");
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAllowNegetiveStockCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            throw new DmException(15000, "Negative Stock is mandatory.");
        }
        boolean isItsRateSlabExists = false, isItsExists = false;
        for (GrdTaxRateSlab_Mdl grdRateITS_Mdl : mrTemp.getGrdLocationWiseGst_Mdls()) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(grdRateITS_Mdl.getSharedKeyFieldCode()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                if (DmShared.xNull(grdRateITS_Mdl.getLocationAndGstCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    throw new DmException(19000, "Location wise GST is Mandatory.");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Notes (hand-written)
- **Menu:** "Item Master" (`ITEM_MASTER`) yahi screen kholta hai (137 fields: finished/trade item).
- `itemMaster` jaisi hi logic (walk-through, `getFinishedItemManualCode`, item-used lock, negative stock rule) **plus**: `corrugationItemMast` (corrugation specifics), variety/grade/classification lookups, GST detail (`fillGSTDetail`, `getGSTDetail`), tax rate slab grid.
- Extra rules: Manual Code mandatory + unique; Item Group ka *item nature* define hona zaroori; **optimistic lock** `u_EntDt_LatestLine`; default values me `enviroCompany.finishedItemUnit` aur `isInventoryAccountingActive` define hone chahiye.

### Validator `PartyMaster_Vld`
```java
public class PartyMaster_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(PartyMaster_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName(), "Name", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getDisplayName(), "Display name", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getAcgroupName(), "A/c group", 300);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getNatureCode(), "nature", 500);
        DmShared.isValidEMail(mrTemp.getEmail(), 400);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getAddress(), "Address", 410);
        DmShared.isValidAmount(mrTemp.getCity(), "City", 450);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPartyType(), "Party Type", 600);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getIsTcsActiveText(), "TCS Active", 1000);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getIsSelfTransportText(), "Self Transport", 970);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getIsActiveText(), "Active", 1060);
        DmShared.isValidMobile(mrTemp.getMobileNo(), 650);
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).length() != 10) {
                throw new DmException(950, "PAN No should be 10 digit.");
            } else {
                DmShared.isValidPanNo(mrTemp.getPan(), 950);
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getNatureManualCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("TP")) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getIsSelfTransportTag()).equalsIgnoreCase("1")) {
                if ((DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase(DmEnum.DmPartyType.Unregistered.getId())
                        || DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase(""))) {
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getTransportId()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(960, " Transporter ID is mandatory");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Registered.getId()))
                || DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Composite.getId()))) {
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGsTin(), "GSTIN No.", 700);
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGsTINDate(), "GSTIN Date", 800);
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTin()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(950, "Please fill the PAN No.");
            } else {
                DmShared.isValidGSTIN(mrTemp.getStateNumericCode(), mrTemp.getPan(), mrTemp.getGsTin(), 700);
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Unregistered.getId()))) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTin()).equalsIgnoreCase("") || !DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(850, "In case of unregistered party type, you should not fill GSTIN No. and GSTIN Date.");
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).getTime() > (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getCurrentDate())).getTime()) {
                throw new DmException(800, "GSTIN Date should not be greater than current date.");
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).length() != 12) {
                throw new DmException(900, "AADHAAR no. should be of 12 digits.");
            }
        }
        DmTermsConfig_Vld.chkSave(mrTemp.getTerms_MdlList());
    }
}
```

### Validator `CustomerMaster_Vld`
```java
public class CustomerMaster_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(CustomerMaster_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName(), "name", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getDisplayName(), "Display name", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getAccGroup(), "A/c group", 300);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getNatureCode(), "nature", 500);
        DmShared.isValidEMail(mrTemp.getEmail(), 400);
        DmShared.isValidAmount(mrTemp.getCity(), "City", 450);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPartyType(), "Party Type", 600);
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).length() != 10) {
                throw new DmException(950, "PAN No should be 10 digit.");
            } else {
                DmShared.isValidPanNo(mrTemp.getPan(), 950);
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Registered.getId()))
                || DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Composite.getId()))) {
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGsTin(), "GSTIN No.", 700);
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGsTINDate(), "GSTIN Date", 800);
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTin()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(950, "Please fill the PAN No.");
            } else {
                DmShared.isValidGSTIN(mrTemp.getStateNumericCode(), mrTemp.getPan(), mrTemp.getGsTin(), 700);
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Unregistered.getId()))) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTin()).equalsIgnoreCase("") || !DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(850, "In case of unregistered party type, you should not fill GSTIN No. and GSTIN Date.");
            }
            if (mrTemp.isGstApplicable() == true) {
                if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(900, "In case of unregistered party type AADHAAR No. or PAN No. is mandatory.");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).getTime() > (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getCurrentDate())).getTime()) {
                throw new DmException(800, "GSTIN Date should not be greater than current date.");
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).length() != 12) {
                throw new DmException(925, "AADHAAR No. should be 12 digit.");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Validator `SupplierMaster_Vld`
```java
public class SupplierMaster_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(SupplierMaster_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName(), "name", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getDisplayName(), "Display name", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getAccGroup(), "A/c group", 300);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getNatureCode(), "nature", 500);
        DmShared.isValidEMail(mrTemp.getEmail(), 400);
        DmShared.isValidAmount(mrTemp.getCity(), "City", 450);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPartyType(), "Party Type", 600);
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).length() != 10) {
                throw new DmException(950, "PAN No should be 10 digit.");
            } else {
                DmShared.isValidPanNo(mrTemp.getPan(), 950);
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Registered.getId()))
                || DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Composite.getId()))) {
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGsTin(), "GSTIN No.", 700);
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGsTINDate(), "GSTIN Date", 800);
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTin()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(950, "Please fill the PAN No.");
            } else {
                DmShared.isValidGSTIN(mrTemp.getStateNumericCode(), mrTemp.getPan(), mrTemp.getGsTin(), 700);
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyType()).equalsIgnoreCase((DmEnum.DmPartyType.Unregistered.getId()))) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTin()).equalsIgnoreCase("") || !DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(850, "In case of unregistered party type, you should not fill GSTIN No. and GSTIN Date.");
            }
            if (mrTemp.isGstApplicable() == true) {
                if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(900, "In case of unregistered party type AADHAAR No. or PAN No. is mandatory.");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getGsTINDate()).getTime() > (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getCurrentDate())).getTime()) {
                throw new DmException(800, "GSTIN Date should not be greater than current date.");
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhar()).length() != 12) {
                throw new DmException(925, "AADHAAR No. should be 12 digit.");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class EmployeeMaster_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(EmployeeMaster_Mdl mrTemp, String currentDate) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName(), "Name", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getDisplayName(), "Display name", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGenderCode(), "Gender", 300);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getAccGroup(), "A/c group", 400);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getNatureCode(), "Nature", 500);
        DmShared.isValidEMail(mrTemp.getEmail(), 700);
        DmShared.isValidMobile(mrTemp.getMobileNo(), 800);
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getSpouseName()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getMaritalStatusShortName()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("B")
                    || DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getMaritalStatusShortName()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(560, "Spouse Name not required.");
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhaarNo()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAadhaarNo()).length() != 12) {
                throw new DmException(550, "AADHAAR should be 12 digit.");
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).equalsIgnoreCase("") && DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPan()).length() != 10) {
            throw new DmException(600, "PAN should be of 10(Ten) characters.");
        }
        if (!DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getDob()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if ((DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getDob()).getTime() >= (DmShared.convertDate(currentDate)).getTime())) {
                throw new DmException(1000, "DOB should be less than to Current Date.");
            }
            if ((!DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getDoa()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) && (!DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getDob()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase(""))) {
                if ((DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getDob()).getTime() >= (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getDoa())).getTime())) {
                    throw new DmException(1000, "DOB should be less than to Anniv. Date.");
                }
            }
            if ((!DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getDoj()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) && (!DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getDob()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase(""))) {
                if ((DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getDob()).getTime() >= (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getDoj())).getTime())) {
                    throw new DmException(1000, "DOB should be less than to Joining Date.");
                }
            }
            if ((!DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getDob()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) && (!DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getPassportIssueDate()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase(""))) {
                if ((DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getDob()).getTime() >= (DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getPassportIssueDate())).getTime())) {
                    throw new DmException(1000, "DOB should be less than to Passport Issue Date.");
                }
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getDoa()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if ((DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getDoa()).getTime() > (DmShared.convertDate(currentDate)).getTime())) {
                throw new DmException(1100, "Anniv. Date should be less than or equal to Current Date.");
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getDoj()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            if ((DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getDoj()).getTime() > (DmShared.convertDate(currentDate)).getTime())) {
```

```java
public class EnvironmentSetting_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(EnvironmentSetting_Mdl mrTemp) {
        boolean isBasedOn = false;
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName(), "Site", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getAgreedRate(), "Agreed Rate", 400);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getIsDiaRequired(), "Is Dia Required", 410);
        if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getIsDiaRequired()).intValue() == 1) {
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getDiaUnitCode(), "Dia Unit", 450);
        }
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getIsDirectSupply(), "Is Direct Supply", 460);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getIsOrderPlanMandatoryCode(), "Order Plan", 500);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getIsSheetBarcodeActiveCode(), "Sheet Barcode Active", 600);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getIsReelBarcodeActiveCode(), "Reel Barcode Active", 610);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGenerateBundleNoTypeCode(), "Generate Bundle No Type", 620);
        List<GrdReelCalculation_Mdl> listItemDetail = mrTemp.getGrdReelCalculation();
        for (GrdReelCalculation_Mdl detail_Mdl : listItemDetail) {
            if (DmShared.iNull(detail_Mdl.getSharedKeyFieldCode()).longValue() != 0
                    || DmShared.iNull(detail_Mdl.getBfCode()).longValue() != 0
                    || DmShared.iNull(detail_Mdl.getGsmCode()).longValue() != 0) {
                if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getBasedOn()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    throw new DmException(650, "Bifurcation detail not required for Reel Calculation Parameter For Specific Items/BF/GSM.");
                }
                if (DmShared.xNull(detail_Mdl.getSharedKeyFieldCode()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getBasedOn()).contains("I")) {
                        throw new DmException(650, "GridRow", DmShared.iNull(listItemDetail.indexOf(detail_Mdl)).toString(), "Item is Mandatory in line no. " + DmShared.iNull(listItemDetail.indexOf(detail_Mdl) + 1).toString() + ".");
                    }
                } else {
                    if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getBasedOn()).contains("I")) {
                        throw new DmException(650, "GridRow", DmShared.iNull(listItemDetail.indexOf(detail_Mdl)).toString(), "Item is not required in line no. " + DmShared.iNull(listItemDetail.indexOf(detail_Mdl) + 1).toString() + ".");
                    }
                }
                if (DmShared.xNull(detail_Mdl.getBfCode()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getBasedOn()).contains("B")) {
                        throw new DmException(650, "GridRow", DmShared.iNull(listItemDetail.indexOf(detail_Mdl)).toString(), "BF is Mandatory in line no. " + DmShared.iNull(listItemDetail.indexOf(detail_Mdl) + 1).toString() + ".");
                    }
                } else {
                    if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getBasedOn()).contains("B")) {
                        throw new DmException(650, "GridRow", DmShared.iNull(listItemDetail.indexOf(detail_Mdl)).toString(), "BF is not required in line no. " + DmShared.iNull(listItemDetail.indexOf(detail_Mdl) + 1).toString() + ".");
                    }
                }
                if (DmShared.xNull(detail_Mdl.getGsmCode()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getBasedOn()).contains("G")) {
                        throw new DmException(650, "GridRow", DmShared.iNull(listItemDetail.indexOf(detail_Mdl)).toString(), "GSM is Mandatory in line no. " + DmShared.iNull(listItemDetail.indexOf(detail_Mdl) + 1).toString() + ".");
                    }
                } else {
                    if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getBasedOn()).contains("G")) {
                        throw new DmException(650, "GridRow", DmShared.iNull(listItemDetail.indexOf(detail_Mdl)).toString(), "GSM is not required in line no. " + DmShared.iNull(listItemDetail.indexOf(detail_Mdl) + 1).toString() + ".");
                    }
                }
                if (DmShared.vNull(detail_Mdl.getReelCalFormulaInch()).doubleValue() <= 0) {
                    throw new DmException(650, "Please fill 1 inch weight.");
                }
                if (DmShared.vNull(detail_Mdl.getReelCalFormulaInch()).doubleValue() <= 0) {
                    throw new DmException(650, "Please fill 1 cm weight.");
                }
                isBasedOn = true;
            }
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getBasedOn()).equalsIgnoreCase("") && isBasedOn == false) {
            throw new DmException(650, "Data required for Reel Calculation Parameter For Specific Items/BF/GSM");
        }
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getGateDefaultUnitCode(), "Default Unit", 700);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getIsPartyMandatoryCode(), "Party", 720);
        List<ItemCategoryGodown_Mdl> listItemCategoryGodown = mrTemp.getItemCategoryGodown();
        for (int i = 0; i < listItemCategoryGodown.size(); i++) {
            for (ItemCategoryGodown_Mdl detail_Mdl : listItemCategoryGodown) {
                for (ItemCategoryGodown_Mdl detail_Mdl2 : listItemCategoryGodown) {
                    if (detail_Mdl.getSharedKeyFieldHashCode() != detail_Mdl2.getSharedKeyFieldHashCode()) {
                        if (DmShared.xNull(detail_Mdl.getSharedKeyFieldCode()).equalsIgnoreCase(DmShared.xNull(detail_Mdl2.getSharedKeyFieldCode()))) {
                            throw new DmException(800, "itemcatRow", DmShared.xNull(detail_Mdl.getSharedKeyFieldCode()), "Duplicate Item Category exist in line no.");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        List<GrdDscConfig_Mdl> ds_Mdls = mrTemp.getGrdDscConfig_Mdls();
        Set<String> uniqueKeys = new HashSet<>();
        for (GrdDscConfig_Mdl ds_Mdl : ds_Mdls) {
            int rowIndex = ds_Mdls.indexOf(ds_Mdl);
            String serialNo = DmShared.xNull(ds_Mdl.getSharedKeyFieldCode());
            String docTypeCode = DmShared.xNull(ds_Mdl.getDocTypeCode());
            String key = serialNo + "|" + docTypeCode;
            if (!uniqueKeys.add(key)) {
                throw new DmException(900, "DSC Config", String.valueOf(rowIndex), "Duplicate 'DSC Config' exists for row no. " + (rowIndex + 1) + ".");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class MasterSitePermission_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(MasterSitePermission_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName(), "Site", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getMasterNatureTag(), "Master Nature", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getMasterNameTag(), "Master Name", 300);
        if (mrTemp.getMasterNatureTag().equalsIgnoreCase(MSPEnum.MasterNature.ITEM.getValue())) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getItemTypeTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                    && DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getItemCatTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                    && DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getItemGroupTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                    && DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getItemNameTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(400, "Please select data for site assign/unassign.");
            }
        } else if (mrTemp.getMasterNatureTag().equalsIgnoreCase(MSPEnum.MasterNature.ACCOUNT.getValue())) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAccountNatureTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                    && DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAccountGroupTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                    && DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAssetCatTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                    && DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAccountNameTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(500, "Please select data for site assign/unassign.");
            }
        } else if (mrTemp.getMasterNatureTag().equalsIgnoreCase(MSPEnum.MasterNature.ASSET.getValue())) {
            if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAssetCatTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                    && DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAssetGroupTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                    && DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getAssetItemTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(600, "Please select data for site assign/unassign.");
            }
        } else if (mrTemp.getMasterNatureTag().equalsIgnoreCase(MSPEnum.MasterNature.SHIFT.getValue())) {
            DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getShiftTag(), "Shift Name", 700);
        }
    }
}
```

### Validator `PriceListMaster_Vld`
```java
public class PriceListMaster_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(SearchValue_Mdl searchValue_Mdl, GrdItemDetail_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(searchValue_Mdl.getPriceListTypeCode(), "Price List Type", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(searchValue_Mdl.getApplicableOnCode(), "Applicable On", 300);
        if (STEnum.PriceListType.getViaKey(DmShared.iNull(searchValue_Mdl.getPriceListTypeCode()).intValue()) != null) {
            switch (STEnum.PriceListType.getViaKey(DmShared.iNull(searchValue_Mdl.getPriceListTypeCode()).intValue())) {
                case BF:
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getBfFromTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(300, "BF from is mandatory!");
                    }
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getBfToTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(400, "BF to is mandatory!");
                    }
                    if (DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getBfFromText()).doubleValue() > DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getBfFromTag()).doubleValue()) {
                        throw new DmException(400, "BF to should be greater than or equal to BF from.");
                    }
                    break;
                case GSM:
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsmFromTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(500, "GSM from is mandatory!");
                    }
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsmToTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(600, "GSM to is mandatory!");
                    }
                    if (DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getGsmFromText()).doubleValue() > DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getGsmFromTag()).doubleValue()) {
                        throw new DmException(600, "GSM to should be greater than or equal to GSM from.");
                    }
                    break;
                case BOTH:
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getBfFromTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(300, "BF from is mandatory!");
                    }
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getBfToTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(400, "BF to is mandatory!");
                    }
                    if (DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getBfFromText()).doubleValue() > DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getBfFromTag()).doubleValue()) {
                        throw new DmException(400, "BF to should be greater than or equal to BF from");
                    }
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsmFromTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(500, "GSM from is mandatory!");
                    }
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getGsmToTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(600, "GSM to is mandatory!");
                    }
                    if (DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getGsmFromText()).doubleValue() > DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getGsmFromTag()).doubleValue()) {
                        throw new DmException(600, "GSM to should be greater than or equal to GSM from.");
                    }
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        } else {
            throw new DmException(200, "Invalid price list type!");
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getFreightTypeCode()).trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new DmException(650, "Freight Type is mandatory!");
        }
        if (DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getRate()).doubleValue() <= 0) {
            throw new DmException(700, "Rate is mandatory!");
        }
        boolean flagApplibaleOnPurchase = false;
        if (!DmShared.xNull(searchValue_Mdl.getApplicableOnCode()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")
                && STEnum.PriceListApplicableOn.getViaKey(DmShared.iNull(searchValue_Mdl.getApplicableOnCode()).intValue()) != null
                && STEnum.PriceListApplicableOn.getViaKey(DmShared.iNull(searchValue_Mdl.getApplicableOnCode()).intValue()).equals(STEnum.PriceListApplicableOn.PURCHASE)) {
            flagApplibaleOnPurchase = true;
        }
        PriceListShared.chkPriceListSchemeGrid(800, mrTemp.getGrdDeductionLst(), flagApplibaleOnPurchase);
        if (flagApplibaleOnPurchase) {
            if (DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getDeductionAmt()).doubleValue() > DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getRate()).doubleValue()) {
                throw new DmException(700, "Deduction value cannot be greater than rate.");
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getEstimatedLandedRate()).doubleValue() < 0) {
            throw new DmException(700, "Estimated landed rate cannot be negative.");
        }
    }
    public static void chkSavePriceList(PriceListMaster_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName()), "Name", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPriceListTypeCode()), "Price List Type", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getApplicableOnCode()), "Applicable On", 300);
        DmShared.isValidText(DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getSiteSpecificCode()), "Site Specific", 350);
        DmShared.isValidText(DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getApplicableFrom()), "Applicable From", 360);
        DmShared.isValidText(DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getApplicableTo()), "Applicable To", 370);
        if (STEnum.PriceListApplicableOn.getViaKey(DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getApplicableOnCode()).intValue()).equals(STEnum.PriceListApplicableOn.PURCHASE)) {
            DmShared.isValidText(DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPartyCode()), "Party", 400);
        }
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldCode()).trim().isEmpty()) {
            if (DmShared.convertDate(DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getApplicableFrom())).getTime() < DmShared.convertDate(DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getLoginDate())).getTime()) {
                throw new DmException(360, "'Applicable From' date should be greater than or equal to current date!");
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.convertDate(DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getApplicableTo())).getTime() <= DmShared.convertDate(DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getApplicableFrom())).getTime()) {
            throw new DmException(370, "'Applicable To' date should be greater than 'Applicable From' date!");
        }
    }
}
```

### Notes (hand-written)
- Sales aur purchase dono ke liye ek hi screen (menu **"Purchase Price List Master"** aur **"Sales Price List Master"**, parameter `APPLICABLE_ON_SHORT_NAME` = PURCHASE/SALES).
- **Asli logic `selfToolkit.PriceList_Server`** me hai (`savePriceList`, `deletePriceList`, `getGridOhDeductionDetails`); master ka `PriceListMaster_SrvImpl` use call karta hai. Isliye is entry ka design `pb-self-toolkit` ke saath hoga.
- Rules: closed price list me change nahi ("'Price List' is closed!"); name unique; party mandatory (type ke hisaab se); **active price list jisme rates hon delete nahi**; closing date >= applicable from; BF/GSM ranges (from <= to) mandatory.
- Tables: `priceListMast`, `guiPriceListHead` (dynamic GUI), `enviroCompany`.

### Validator `PartyPriceList_Vld`
```java
public class PartyPriceList_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(PartyPriceList_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldCode(), "Party", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPriceListTag(), "Price List", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPriceListTypeTag(), "Price List Type", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getApplicableOnTag(), "Applicable On", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getEffectiveDate(), "Effective Date", 300);
        for (GrdItemDetail_Mdl gim : mrTemp.getGrdItemDetails()) {
            String lineNo = DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getGrdItemDetails().indexOf(gim)).toString();
            if (!DmShared.xNull(gim.getSharedKeyFieldCode()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                if (DmShared.xNull(gim.getUnitCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "Unit is mandatory");
                }
                if (STEnum.PriceListType.getViaKey(DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getPriceListTypeTag()).intValue()) != null) {
                    switch (STEnum.PriceListType.getViaKey(DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getPriceListTypeTag()).intValue())) {
                        case BF:
                            if (DmShared.xNull(gim.getBfFromTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                                throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "BF from is mandatory");
                            }
                            if (DmShared.xNull(gim.getBfToTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                                throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "BF to is mandatory");
                            }
                            if (DmShared.vNull(gim.getBfFromText()).doubleValue() > DmShared.vNull(gim.getBfFromTag()).doubleValue()) {
                                throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "BF to should be greater than or equal to BF from");
                            }
                            break;
                        case GSM:
                            if (DmShared.xNull(gim.getGsmFromTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                                throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "GSM from is mandatory");
                            }
                            if (DmShared.xNull(gim.getGsmToTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                                throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "GSM to is mandatory");
                            }
                            if (DmShared.vNull(gim.getGsmFromText()).doubleValue() > DmShared.vNull(gim.getGsmFromTag()).doubleValue()) {
                                throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "GSM to should be greater than or equal to GSM from");
                            }
                            break;
                        case BOTH:
                            if (DmShared.xNull(gim.getBfFromTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                                throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "BF from is mandatory");
                            }
                            if (DmShared.xNull(gim.getBfToTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                                throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "BF to is mandatory");
                            }
                            if (DmShared.vNull(gim.getBfFromText()).doubleValue() > DmShared.vNull(gim.getBfFromTag()).doubleValue()) {
                                throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "BF to should be greater than or equal to BF from");
                            }
                            if (DmShared.xNull(gim.getGsmFromTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                                throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "GSM from is mandatory");
                            }
                            if (DmShared.xNull(gim.getGsmToTag()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                                throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "GSM to is mandatory");
                            }
                            if (DmShared.vNull(gim.getGsmFromText()).doubleValue() > DmShared.vNull(gim.getGsmFromTag()).doubleValue()) {
                                throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "GSM to should be greater than or equal to GSM from");
                            }
                            break;
                        default:
                            break;
                    }
                } else {
                    throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "Invalid price list type");
                }
                if (DmShared.vNull(gim.getRate()).doubleValue() <= 0) {
                    throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "Rate is mandatory");
                }
                if (STEnum.PriceListApplicableOn.getViaKey(DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getApplicableOnTag()).intValue()).equals(STEnum.PriceListApplicableOn.PURCHASE)) {
                    if (DmShared.vNull(gim.getDeductionAmt()).doubleValue() > DmShared.vNull(gim.getRate()).doubleValue()) {
                        throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "Deduction value cannot be greater than rate");
                    }
                }
                if (DmShared.vNull(gim.getEstimatedLandedRate()).doubleValue() < 0) {
                    throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, "Estimated landed rate cannot be negative");
                }
                try {
                    PriceListShared.chkPriceListSchemeGrid(400, gim.getGrdDeductionLst(), false);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    throw new DmException(400, "GridRow", lineNo, e.getMessage());
                }
            }
        }
        for (GrdPriceListCommission_Mdl priceListCommission_Mdl : mrTemp.getGrdPricelstCommission()) {
            String lineNo = DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getGrdPricelstCommission().indexOf(priceListCommission_Mdl)).toString();
            if (!DmShared.xNull(priceListCommission_Mdl.getSharedKeyFieldCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                if (DmShared.vNull(priceListCommission_Mdl.getAtRate()).doubleValue() == 0 && DmShared.vNull(priceListCommission_Mdl.getAmount()).doubleValue() == 0) {
                    throw new DmException(500, "GridRow", lineNo, "Rate or Amount is required");
                }
                if (DmShared.dNull(priceListCommission_Mdl.getApplicableFrom()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    throw new DmException(500, "GridRow", lineNo, "Applicable From is required");
                }
                if (DmShared.dNull(priceListCommission_Mdl.getApplicableTo()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    throw new DmException(500, "GridRow", lineNo, "Applicable To is required");
                }
                if ((DmShared.convertDate(priceListCommission_Mdl.getApplicableFrom()).getTime() < DmShared.convertDate(mrTemp.getEffectiveDate()).getTime())) {
                    throw new DmException(500, "GridRow", lineNo, "Applicable From is less than effective date");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Validator `ChangePriceList_Vld`
```java
public class ChangePriceList_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(ChangePriceList_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getEntryFromCode(), "Entry From", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getApplicableOnCode(), "Applicable On", 200);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPriceListTypeCode(), "Type", 300);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSiteSpecificCode(), "Site Specific", 400);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getApplicableDate(), "Applicable Date", 500);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPriceListCode(), "Price List", 600);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getActionTypeCode(), "Action Type", 700);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getChangeTypeCode(), "Change Type", 800);
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getNewPriceListCode()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("") && DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPriceListCode()).split(",").length > 1) {
            throw new DmException(600, "Multiple price list can not be copied to a New price list!");
        }
        if (!DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getNewPriceListCode()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("") && DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getPriceListCode()).equalsIgnoreCase(DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getNewPriceListCode()))) {
            throw new DmException(600, "New price list name and Price list name can not be same!");
        }
        if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getActionTypeCode()).intValue() == 1) {
            if (DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getNewApplicableDate()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                throw new DmException(900, "Please enter New Applicable Date!");
            }
        }
        if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getChangeTypeCode()).intValue() != 3) {
            if (DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getRateAt()).doubleValue() == 0 && DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getRateValue()).doubleValue() == 0) {
                throw new DmException(1000, "Please enter Rate(%) Or Rate(Value)!");
            } else {
                if (DmShared.iNull(mrTemp.getChangeTypeCode()).intValue() == 2) {
                    if (DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getRateAt()).doubleValue() >= 100) {
                        throw new DmException(1000, "Rate(%) can not be greater than or equal to 100%!");
                    }
                }
                if (DmShared.vNull(mrTemp.getRateValue()).doubleValue() >= 0) {
                    if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getUnitCode()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        throw new DmException(1100, "Unit is medatory!");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class SchemeMaster_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(Scheme_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName().trim(), "scheme", 100);
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getApplicableFromDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            throw new DmException(400, "From date is Mandatory");
        }
        boolean flag = false;
        List<GrdItemDetail_Mdl> listItemDetail = mrTemp.getGrdData();
        for (GrdItemDetail_Mdl detail_Mdl : listItemDetail) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(detail_Mdl.getItemCatCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")
                    || !DmShared.xNull(detail_Mdl.getItemCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")
                    || !DmShared.xNull(detail_Mdl.getSchemeGroupCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                flag = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!flag) {
            throw new DmException(500, "Scheme detail is mandatory.");
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class PartyScheme_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(PartyScheme_Mdl mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldCode().trim(), "Scheme", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getPartyCode().trim(), "Party", 500);
        if (DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getApplicableFromDate()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
            throw new DmException(400, "From date is Mandatory");
        }
        boolean flag = false;
        List<GrdItemDetail_Mdl> listItemDetail = mrTemp.getGrdData();
        for (GrdItemDetail_Mdl detail_Mdl : listItemDetail) {
            if (!DmShared.xNull(detail_Mdl.getItemCatCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")
                    || !DmShared.xNull(detail_Mdl.getItemCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")
                    || !DmShared.xNull(detail_Mdl.getSchemeGroupCode()).equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                flag = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!flag) {
            throw new DmException(500, "Scheme detail is mandatory.");
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class TranspoterRateContract_Vld {
    public static void chkSave(TranspoterRateContract_Mdl mrTemp) {
        List<TranspoterDetail_Mdl> listData;
        boolean flag = false;
        String duplicateTransporterDetailCondition = "";
        DmShared.isValidText(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName(), "Contract Name", 100);
        DmShared.isValidText(DmShared.dNull(mrTemp.getApplicableFrom()), "Applicable Date", 400);
        listData = mrTemp.getGrdData();
        if (listData != null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < listData.size(); i++) {
                if (!DmShared.xNull(listData.get(i).getSharedKeyFieldCode()).trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                    flag = true;
                    for (int j = i + 1; j < listData.size(); j++) {
                        if (DmShared.xNull(listData.get(j).getSharedKeyFieldCode()).equalsIgnoreCase(listData.get(i).getSharedKeyFieldCode())
                                && DmShared.xNull(listData.get(j).getRateTypeCode()).equalsIgnoreCase(listData.get(i).getRateTypeCode())
                                && DmShared.xNull(listData.get(j).getVehicleTypeCode()).equalsIgnoreCase(listData.get(i).getVehicleTypeCode())
                                && DmShared.xNull(listData.get(j).getCityCode()).equalsIgnoreCase(listData.get(i).getCityCode())
                                && DmShared.xNull(listData.get(j).getAreaCode()).equalsIgnoreCase(listData.get(i).getAreaCode())) {
                            throw new DmException(500, "Duplicate Record Defined For Transporter: " + listData.get(i).getSharedKeyFieldName() + "");
                        }
                    }
                    if (!duplicateTransporterDetailCondition.trim().equalsIgnoreCase("")) {
                        duplicateTransporterDetailCondition += " OR ";
                    } else {
                        duplicateTransporterDetailCondition += " ";
                    }
                    duplicateTransporterDetailCondition += " (ISNULL(tprcd.transporterCode, 0) = '" + DmShared.xNull(listData.get(i).getSharedKeyFieldCode()) + "'";
                    duplicateTransporterDetailCondition += " AND ISNULL(tprcd.vehicleTypeCode, 0) = '" + DmShared.xNull(listData.get(i).getVehicleTypeCode()) + "'";
                    duplicateTransporterDetailCondition += " AND ISNULL(tprcd.cityCode, 0) = '" + DmShared.xNull(listData.get(i).getCityCode()) + "'";
                    duplicateTransporterDetailCondition += " AND ISNULL(tprcd.areaCode, 0) = '" + DmShared.xNull(listData.get(i).getAreaCode()) + "'";
                    duplicateTransporterDetailCondition += " AND ISNULL(tprcd.type, 0) = '" + DmShared.xNull(listData.get(i).getRateTypeCode()) + "')";
                }
            }
        }
        mrTemp.setDuplicateTransporterDetailCondition(duplicateTransporterDetailCondition);
        if (!flag) {
            throw new DmException(600, "Transporter detail is mandatory.");
        }
    }
    public static void chkSaveContractName(KeyFieldExtended mrTemp) {
        DmShared.isValidText(DmShared.xNull(mrTemp.getSharedKeyFieldName()), "Name", 100);
    }
}
```
